items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: That was the greatest band I ever played with in my life, the band that Billy Eckstine had at the Regal Theatre in Chicago. They had Charlie Parker, Lucky Thompson, Dexter Gordon, Leo Parker, and who else was there... The trumpets, they had me and Dizzy, Shorts, and

ctx.x: What appealed to you, though, about the new music specifically? It allowed you to do different things?

Yeah. Well, the reason why I liked it was because it was a challenge. Like, can you do this and can you do that? With most of the guys that was playing, they could do this and they could do that. Like, Lucky Thompson was out there at the time, you know. And every session we'd get on, we'd always see who did what. Which was like a challenge to make you aware of what you was doing.
Well, it was a pretty active scene out there, Central Avenue and Hollywood...
